start: Enquiries screen, an open enquiry typed in by hand, number not on the member list

steps.action: Tap 'Add as member' on the row
user_sees: The usual Add member form, with the name and the number already filled in
must_not: An empty form
The number changed or cut

user_sees: The form closes
The new member's page opens
must_not: Two members made from one save
The member saved while the enquiry stays open with no word about it

steps.action: Go back to Enquiries and open the joined list
user_sees: The row with a green 'Joined' pill and an 'Open member' button
must_not: 'Add as member' still offered on the joined row
The row linked to a different member

start: Today screen, 'Joined online' card: a person asked to join online and picked a plan

user_sees: The Add member form with the name and number filled in
must_not: A different person's details in the form

user_sees: The Sell membership sheet opens by itself, on the plan and the start day they picked online
must_not: The flow closing before Sell membership opens
A plan picked that is not the one they asked for

user_sees: The new member's page opens
must_not: Money shown as collected when nothing was paid at the desk
Two memberships sold from one tap

start: Enquiries screen, an open enquiry whose number already belongs to a member on the list

user_sees: Sheet titled 'Already a member'
'<member's name> is already a member with <number>.'
Buttons 'Cancel' and 'Mark joined and open'
must_not: The Add member form opened for a number that would be refused

user_sees: The enquiry closes as joined, linked to that member
That member's page opens
must_not: A second member with the same number
The button pressable twice while it saves

start: Enquiries screen, an open enquiry whose number belongs to an archived member

user_sees: Sheet titled 'Already a member (archived)'
'<name> already has <number>, but they were archived, so they are not in the list.'
Buttons 'Cancel' and 'Bring back and mark joined'
must_not: The archived member left hidden with no way to link them

user_sees: The member is back on the member list
The enquiry is joined and linked to them
Their page opens
must_not: The member brought back while the enquiry stays open and no message says so
The sheet swapping to 'Already a member' half-way

start: Enquiries screen, one open enquiry, one joined, one not interested

steps.action: Tap 'Add as member' on the open one, then close the Add member form without saving
user_sees: Back on Enquiries; the enquiry is still open
must_not: A member saved
The enquiry marked joined

steps.action: Look at the joined row and the not-interested row
user_sees: No 'Add as member' button on either
must_not: A joined enquiry that can be made a member a second time

steps.action: Save the member while the enquiry itself cannot be saved
user_sees: A red line on Enquiries: the server's words, or 'The member was saved, but the enquiry was not closed.'
must_not: The member lost
A message that everything was saved

start: Enquiries screen, an enquiry made a member a minute ago

user_sees: The row shows 'Joined' and 'Open member'; no call-back line
must_not: A 'Reopen' button on a joined row
The enquiry still counted under call today

user_sees: That member's page
must_not: Another member's page
A blank page when the member was archived later

start: Enquiries screen, a person who took a free trial on the gym's web page

user_sees: 'Free trial online: <n> days, <first day> to <last day>. Nothing paid.'
must_not: The person already on the member list before anyone taps Add as member
The word 'Paid' on a trial

user_sees: Sell membership opens with no plan picked for them, when the gym has an active plan
must_not: A plan sold by itself
A receipt made for the free trial
